prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
sign_in, copy changes remain helpful, winning 5 out of 13 tests (+1.3% average after noise correction), while 8 showed no clear effect.
home, wait_info changes are helpful, winning 4 out of 11 tests (+1.6% average after noise correction), while 7 showed no clear effect.
adoption, redesign changes are helpful, winning 4 out of 10 tests (+1.4% average after noise correction), while 1 performed worse and 5 showed no clear effect.
choose_path, redesign changes are helpful, winning 2 out of 6 tests (+1.6% average after noise correction), while 4 showed no clear effect.
choose_path, copy, finish, redesign, finish, new_screen, home, new_flow, and adoption, layout changes consistently showed no clear effect or performed worse across multiple tests.
Predictions were overly optimistic for finish, new_screen, finish, redesign, choose_path, copy, and home, new_flow changes, predicting higher gains than actual results which were mostly negative or showed no clear effect.

Changes:
0: [home, wait_info] Desktop Engine Launch Progress Wait Info: Adds an estimated launch timer and engine load progress checklist display to the waiting screen while the desktop pet initializes. (why: Home step has a median time of 201s (mean 2336s), and prior test results show wait_info changes on home reliably boost conversion (+1.6% average).)
1: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Companion Showcase Redesign: Redesigns the friend selection screen into a spotlight layout with animated pet preview choice cards. (why: Adoption step has an 11.9% drop-off rate, and redesign changes in adoption have proven effective in past testing (+1.4% average).)
2: [sign_in, copy] Account Pet Cloud Sync Guarantee Headline: Updates sign-in screen headline and body text to clearly explain that signing in preserves pet profiles across logins and updates. (why: 8 support messages reported pets missing or reset after signing in again, and sign_in copy changes have a strong win rate (+1.3% average).)
3: [adoption, hint] Custom Pet Generation Diagnostic Tip: Adds a tip carousel with clear lighting and quality guidance to the photo upload screen during custom pet adoption. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failing or rendering incorrectly during the adoption stage.)
4: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Quick Controls Guide Screen: Inserts a dedicated controls guide screen right before completing onboarding to demonstrate pet movement and shortcut menus. (why: Finish step drops 23.0% of users, and 3 support tickets noted confusion over how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after setup.)
5: [home, notification] Desktop Engine Ready Desktop Notification: Enables OS desktop notifications on the waiting screen to alert users when the desktop engine finish initializing. (why: Home step has a 201s median / 2336s mean waiting time, causing users to abandon the app while waiting for desktop rendering.)
